name: clawforce
description: Deploy AI agents via OpenClaw and Docker Compose

scripts.precommit:dashboard: pnpm --dir clawforce-dashboard lint && pnpm --dir clawforce-dashboard test
scripts.check:root: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm knip --include dependencies,unlisted,unresolved
scripts.check:dashboard: pnpm --dir clawforce-dashboard lint && pnpm --dir clawforce-dashboard build && pnpm --dir clawforce-dashboard test && pnpm knip --directory clawforce-dashboard --include dependencies,unlisted,unresolved
scripts.check:ci: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:smoke && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm knip --include dependencies,unlisted,unresolved && pnpm check:security
scripts.precommit:verify: pnpm check:root && pnpm check:dashboard && pnpm check:security
